# Conduct & Wellbeing

- **Inclusion.** The lab welcomes people of all backgrounds, identities, and life circumstances. Good science needs people who notice different things and ask different questions, which arises from welcoming individuals with different life experiences.
- **Respectful conduct.** No harassment or discrimination. Everyone in the lab shares responsibility for calling out behavior that doesn't belong here, not just the person it's aimed at. We follow UT Dallas's Title IX and conduct policies as a baseline.
- **Conflict resolution.** Bring problems to me directly when you're comfortable doing so. When the PI is part of the problem, or you'd rather not go through me, these are independent paths at UT Dallas:
  - HR / Employee Relations: Ellen Ammons, <ellen.ammons@utdallas.edu>, 972-883-4633 (general HR: <hr@utdallas.edu>, 972-883-2221)
  - Title IX Coordinator: Heather Dragoo, <heather.dragoo@utdallas.edu>, 972-883-2306
  - Ethics and Compliance Hotline (anonymous): 1-866-962-1233 or [integritycounts.ca/org/utdallas](https://www.integritycounts.ca/org/utdallas)
- **Wellbeing.** A sustainable pace beats a sprint that burns you out. Mental health is not a weakness to manage quietly — use your benefits, take real vacation, and expect flexibility around caregiving or health needs. I try to model this myself, not just say it.
- **Accessibility.** The lab will default to accessible options as much as possible. In cases where the status quo is not sufficient, tell me what you need rather than me guessing; we'll figure out accommodations together, and asking never counts against you.
